Figure1.conclusion: TrustDive converts a deterministic global score into reference-adapted scoring and exact phase evidence.

Figure2.conclusion: Reference adaptation reduces score error overall and in high-disagreement performances.

Figure3.conclusion: Enlarged real query phases and matched training references make the score decomposition inspectable in a typical and a high-disagreement performance.

Figure4.conclusion: Exact phase attributions agree with direct interventions better than random phase selection.

Figure5.conclusion: Phase evidence is informative but only moderately stable to boundary and reference changes.
